changes.comment: BREAKING: a subscription records the principals that may bind and drain its delivery. ISubscribeRequest.drainPrincipals (de-duplicated, then non-empty and at most maxDrainPrincipals distinct; stored ascending) defaults to the registering principal alone, and the registrant is not added when a list is given; TaskBroker.bindDelivery refuses any other principal with not-found-or-denied, the answer a missing subscription gets, and so does TaskDeliveryPump.create; a malformed binding is invalid whether or not the subscription exists. Every IBoundTaskDelivery operation applies the rule again to the subscription as it stands. Hosts that subscribe on an agent's behalf and let the agent drain must name the agent. A persisted subscription written without drain principals is drained by its registrant alone (drainPrincipalsOf; ITaskSubscription.drainPrincipals reports the rule applied). New TaskBroker.setSubscriptionDrain, through the registering principal's binding, replaces the drain principals and the recorded policy identity; a retry of the original subscribe after a change is conflict. BREAKING: IBoundTaskDelivery.disposeWithheld now requires the subscription to have recorded a policy identity (ISubscribeRequest.policyIdentity) and the binding's policy to carry the same one (new optional ITaskAuthorization.policyIdentity, read at binding; trustedKindAuthority takes it); it accepts any drain principal rather than only the registrant. A subscription without a recorded identity refuses every disposeWithheld. BREAKING: TaskBroker.dispose and closeSubscription with obligations 'dispose' now require a binding whose principal is one of the subscription's drain principals, and closeSubscription with 'retain' a drain principal or the registering principal; anyone else gets not-found-or-denied, re-decided in the writing section. A host that registered on an agent's behalf and must dispose names itself among the drain principals. A retry of a registration recorded without drain principals now replays when it names the registrant alone. BREAKING (implementers only): ITaskRepositoryWriter gains setSubscriptionDrain.
